name: Unsweetened chocolat 🥛★
source:
This game is divided into chapters instead of routes since the choice-based system is focused on the impact of how your MC progresses into the story instead of romancing. Needless to say, romance is present, but isn't the focus.

[YOUR MC] suddenly wakes up in an unknown room with an unfamiliar man who seems to know them. After a hectic assessment of their whereabouts, they conclude an unlikely scenario they never thought of before: being trapped inside the otome they bought the day before. Each barrier that prevents them from returning their world unlocks after a character is saved from their bad ending.

At some point, events are easy to solve, until it appears like one of the characters is self-aware and doesn't like the idea of MC leaving without them...

[From [url=https://myaumysu.itch.io/unsweetenedchocolat]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
本作以章节而非角色路线划分。选择系统关注的，是主人公如何推进故事，而非如何攻略恋爱对象。当然，爱情依然存在，只是不再是核心。

你设定的主人公突然在陌生房间醒来，身边有个从未见过、却似乎认识自己的男人。慌乱地弄清处境后，主人公得出一个从未设想过的离奇结论：自己被困在了前一天购买的乙女游戏里。每当一名角色被从坏结局中拯救出来，阻挡主人公返回原世界的一道障碍就会解除。

起初，一切都很容易解决，直到某位角色似乎觉醒了自我意识，而且不愿让主人公独自离开……

[摘自[url=https://myaumysu.itch.io/unsweetenedchocolat]Itch.io[/url]]
